# How to Create Audio with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to generate speech audio from text using a reusable voice asset, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and…

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_speech_create_audio`

## Prompt

```text
Generate speech audio from this text using voice asset id {voice asset id} and model id speech-standard.
```

## Review before approval

- `links` (optional): Optional reference links submitted from the Playground form.
- `model` (optional): Generation model label or version selected in the Playground form.
- `model_id` (optional): Stable public Medux model identifier.
- `text` (optional): Provide the value described in the API reference.
- `title` (optional): Provide the value described in the API reference.
- `voice_asset_id` (required): Reusable voice asset used for text-to-speech generation.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
